newsitem.title: TAJIKISTAN: Russian serviceman murdered in Tajik capital.
newsitem.headline: Russian serviceman murdered in Tajik capital.

text.p: A junior Russian officer was shot dead in the Tajik capital Dushanbe on Saturday, the sixth Russian on peacekeeping duty killed in the city this year, a Russian military source in the former Soviet republic said.
The source told Reuters that the non-commissioned officer Alexei Belanovsky, 32, was shot dead with a pistol on his way to work.
About 20,000 Russian soldiers are on peacekeeping mission in the Central Asian state, which is racked by internal conflict, and help guard Tajikistan's border with Afghanistan.
Russian servicemen have often come under attacks but no-one has claimed responsibility for the incidents.
Radical opponents of the current Tajik government and criminal groups involved in drug traffic are most often pointed to as possible assailants.
